ops.body: - Planning a journey on real streets (measured Nov 18 over Providence's real tiles and the live stores pack, on a desktop): a route between two places costs 40 to 80 ms over the 27,000 street segments about a city centre, a failed one most; a town's chapter asks for 15 to 17, so 0.6 to 1.0 s, and a journey plans up to eight towns for up to four cards, all on the page's own thread with no worker. Unmeasured on a phone, where it will be several times slower. The street router also finds no route to a shop inside a mall or on a campus within half a kilometre (two of Providence's nearest four bookshops): such a shop is now kept out of a walk (outing-journey audit 62) but could be a stop reached to its nearest street.
